data.text: Topic control 2026-10-04: after adding kadence-journal to bogutskiandriy/kadence, search/repositories topic:kadence-journal returned it at once (1 repo), and north-star.mjs --search --include-self read its journal from the tree (300 events sampled, 1 author, 30 d). Code search still returned 0 for every query, as on 2026-09-16 — the topic is the only channel that sees this repository. topic:kadence, by contrast, holds 8 unrelated repositories (WordPress Kadence themes, a Kadence language), which is why the README asks for kadence-journal. Not appended to the log: a control, not a weekly row.
